verses.1: And it happened that when the king sat in his house, Jehovah allowed him to be free from all his troubles.
verses.2: And the king said to the prophet Nathan, “Look, I am sitting in the house of cedars, while the Ark of God is placed within it.”
verses.3: And Nathan said to the king, “Do whatever is right in your heart. For the LORD will be with you.”
verses.4: And in that night, God spoke to Nathan with these words:
verses.5: Go and say to my servant David, “As the LORD says, ‘You shall build for me a house where I may dwell.’”
verses.6: For I have not sat in the house during all the days when I brought the children of Israel out of Egypt, up to this day. And now, I will walk in the tabernacle and in the shelter.
verses.7: In all the places where I traveled throughout all of Israel’s tribes, I said to one of Israel’s rulers, “Why haven’t you built me a house of cedar?”
verses.8: And now, this is what the Lord says to my servant David: “I will take you from among the sheep, from behind the flock, so that you may be a judge over My people, over Israel.”
verses.9: And I will be with you in everything you do. I will take away all your troubles from before you. And I will make you a great name, just like the great names that have been created on this earth.
verses.10: And I gave my people, the Israelites, a place to live in. I planted them there, and they settled down under its shade. They will no longer be oppressed, nor will they be subjected to the insults of their enemies, as they were before.
verses.11: And from today onward, I will judge my people Israel. I will let you be free from all your troubles. The LORD says that in the house of Jacob you will be blessed.
verses.12: For your days will come to an end, and you will lie down with your ancestors. Then I will raise up another generation after you, from among your descendants. And I will prepare a king for them.
verses.13: He will build a house for my name. I will also prepare a throne for her, forever.
verses.14: I will be his father, and he will be my son. He will live in the midst of people’s lives, and his hands will touch the children of men.
verses.15: And my grace will not be withdrawn from me, just as I was withdrawn from Shaul, whom I had removed from before you.
verses.16: And may your house and your queen be praised forever before you. Your throne shall be a place of honor forever.
verses.17: All these things, and all these visions, were spoken by Nathan to David.
verses.18: And King David came and sat before Jehovah. He said, “Who am I, O LORD? And whose house am I, that you would bring me here until now?”
verses.19: And it shall be seen in your eyes, O LORD of hosts. And it shall also be spoken to your servants from afar off. This is the law of man, O LORD of hosts.
verses.20: And David will continue to speak to you. And you shall know who your servants are, O LORD God.
verses.21: In your name and in the name of your dog, you have done all these great things, so that you might reveal your servants.
verses.22: Therefore, O LORD, you have been exalted above all others. There is no god like you in all those we have heard about through our ears.
verses.23: And like your people, Israel was also a single nation on this earth. God went to save them as a people, and gave them a name. He also did great and wonderful things for your land, through your people. You have freed you from Egypt, from those nations and their gods.
verses.24: May your people, Israel, be prepared for you as a people forever. And you, the Lord, will be their God.
verses.25: And now, LORD God, may what you have said about your servant and his house be fulfilled forever. May it be done as you have spoken.
verses.26: And your name shall be exalted forever, “Yahweh, the God of Israel.” And David, your servant, will be faithful before you.
verses.27: For you, O LORD, are the army of heaven, the God of Israel. You have made your servant’s ear sensitive to hearing your words. Thus, your servant has found the courage to pray to you. This is his prayer.
verses.28: And now, O LORD Yahweh, you are the God who speaks truth. Your words will always be true. Speak to your servants of these good things.
verses.29: And now, let me bless your servant’s house, so that it may be blessed forever before you. For you are the Lord Yahweh who has spoken and granted blessings to your servant’s house forever.
